testcase.name: Scenario: Apply a feature suppression change through the model-state table: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1367:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply a feature suppression change through the model-state table ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State ✔ And the user sets the extrusion to Suppress in Primary and Capture State and Compute in Copy State through the model-state table ✔ And the user activates Copy State ✔ And The MCAD Software has an extrusion suppressed in Primary and computed in Copy State ✔ And Copy State is active ✔ And the active view representation permits the extrusion's solid body to be visible ✔ When the user opens the model-state table ✔ And changes the Primary extrusion cell to Compute ✔ And accepts the table ✔ And activates the Primary model state ✔ Then the solid produced by the extrusion is visible ✔ When the user reopens the model-state table ✔ Then the Primary extrusion cell displays Compute ✔ When the user changes the Primary extrusion cell to Suppress and accepts the table ✔ Then the solid is absent from the viewport ✔ And the extrusion row is struck through ✔ When the user activates Copy State ✔ Then the solid is visible again ✔ And the extrusion row is no longer struck through
